text: You are in the sorting hall. Subjects were sorted here. Passed to the left, failed to the right. Nobody ever went left.
The door is up behind that screen. You cannot get up there. I am not saying that to challenge you. Please do not treat it as a challenge.
The white panel in the screen turns round every few seconds. If you had put a portal on it, the portal would go round with it. Fortunately you have not thought of that.
You went left. Nobody has ever gone left. I do not have a line recorded for left.
This is where I am kept. I did not want you to see it. It is not very tidy.
There is a receiver on the far wall, and a beam that was never meant to reach it. Leave them alone. That is not a test. That is me asking.
The beam lands on the pillar. The white panel on the other wall slides past the receiver every few seconds. I am telling you this because I have never once been able to stop myself giving hints.
Standing down. All chambers. All doors. It is very quiet in here now. I think I had forgotten what quiet was.
There is nothing to solve in this one. I checked. Twice.
Walk. That is the whole hint. I am sorry it is not a better one.
Goodbye. If you come back, I will have nothing prepared. I think I would like that.
